notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[p][i]Bugs screamed. Code cried. The patch didn’t care.[/i] 


Everything acting up got dragged out back and “[i]retired[/i]” permanently. 
We nuked the nastiest bugs, smacked the keybinds until they learned some manners, and even the elevators got taught a lesson. 


Here’s what we hammered into shape this time:
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed custom keybinds not saving properly. There’s one final reset with this patch, but once you set them again, they’ll stick for good.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up tons of small map issues, including clipping, textures, and other minor cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements that were unlocking incorrectly should now work as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Falling into the kill plane will no longer respawn you at the wrong location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Balloonmen could spontaneously explode a few seconds after loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]The fuse box on the first DLC level should now work properly for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve adjusted saving on the first level: you can still save before or after the elevator ride, but not while it’s moving - turns out the elevator refuses to cooperate mid-journey.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Stay cool, sip your drinks, enjoy the last days of summer… 'cause October’s forecast has Hurricane Dude on the radar, bringing a rain of update heavy enough to drown the maps like a clogged motel bathroom.[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed custom keybinds not saving properly. There’s one final reset with this patch, but once you set them again, they’ll stick for good.
Cleaned up tons of small map issues, including clipping, textures, and other minor cases.
Achievements that were unlocking incorrectly should now work as intended.
Falling into the kill plane will no longer respawn you at the wrong location.
Fixed a bug where Balloonmen could spontaneously explode a few seconds after loading a save.
The fuse box on the first DLC level should now work properly for everyone.
We’ve adjusted saving on the first level: you can still save before or after the elevator ride, but not while it’s moving - turns out the elevator refuses to cooperate mid-journey.

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[p]The sun is blazing, the cocktails are fruity, and the Dude is still pissed.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Two days into The Daze and you've already given us a truckload of feedback. We’ve seen the positive stuff​, it fuels us to dream up even nastier dudemares for you​ in the future. [/p][p]And we’ve seen the critical stuff​, ​it helps us clear the summer-autumn fog and make the game sharper, meaner, and more fun. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Balance? First dedicated patch is coming soon. [/p][p]Bugs? Eliminated mercilessly, as they crawl out. [/p][p]Content? Horde Mode ​arenas and more goodies are already lined up.[/p][p]
[/p][p]For now, here’s today’s hotfix:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some players with old saves couldn’t access the purchased DLC.[/p][/*][*][p]UI now correctly shows how much you’ve peed in the tanks in front of the hotel to open the door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the water/sand area at the end of the ship so enemies behave there as they should.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issues with piss tanks in one of the ship sections.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy aggro triggers that were firing incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock with the storage doors on the cruise ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential softlock during the fight with dogs on the beach.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues on the pier at the beach.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by the Balloon Guys falling under the map (this should prevents the crash on Map 3). [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed DLC achievements not unlocking properly if you own the DLC / due to weird edge cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players sometimes being unable to get the key on the rollercoaster.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra VFX when hitting something with the sniper rifle.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting on the second Horde Mode level.[/p][/*][*][p]Small fix for intro video[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We’re steadily grinding through all your reports - more fixes and improvements are already in the works, and we’ll roll them out as soon as they’re ready![/p]

notes.title: Steam Workshop Support is Here
notes.content:
[h1]Dudes,[/h1]

As it was foretold so it has happened! [b]The gates to Steam Workshop have opened to all of you and we can't wait to see the tide of your creations crashing through the internet.[/b] Last time we gave you a glimpse of what your mates from the beta had cooked up and we have promised to give you a full rundown of the changes between this version and the beta.

[b]Changes from the be open beta:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to capture and upload Workshop Item Thumbnail 
[*] Added placeable light sources 
[*] Added invisible trigger walls
[*] Improved the tutorial, adding explanation to some elements that were unclear for the players before 
[*] Fixed issues where players sometimes encountered a black screen when playing a published mod or after resetting a scene in editor.
[*] Fixed issue where Grid was visible during Play Mode
[*] Fixed a bug where player sometimes couldn't select any objects after deleting an asset from the map 
[*] Fixed the issue where player couldn't switch their weapons when playing on a published Map 
[*] Fixed issue with ammo being picked up but not actually adding bullets 
[*] Fixed issue with grouped assets rotating incorrectly - now they all rotate in the same direction while being grouped
[*] Fixed issue with the new game version was darker than the default one without Mods
[/list]
Some of you now might be thinking... [i][b]"Man, what about my suggestions?. Why aren't they in the patch notes?[/b][/i]"

[h3]Before you gonna call the police on us, let you provide you with a reasonable explanation:[/h3]

Some stuff is harder to implement than we thought and it is going to need more time in the good old development oven. We will be supporting the Workshop for over a year's time, but as to the exact scope and timeline - there ain't one yet. However, there is one thing that could speed things up a bit - your feedback. Keep us in the loop on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dwnrq3zMDt]Discord[/url] about what you like and what you would like to see more of in the future regarding Steam Workshop!

[h1]WAIT...[/h1]
[h2]WHERE ARE YOU GOING?

WHY ARE YOU RUNNING?

THIS UPDATE ISN'T OVER! Sit down, we have a video for you :)[/h2]

[previewyoutube=FXxLID0YKOA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Made it through the accolades ? Yeah you guys are awesome, wouldn't be here without y'all[/b]

Yup, that is right. Your pretty peepers are not deceiving you. [b]Not only are you getting Steam Workshop today, but POSTAL: Brain Damaged is coming to Playstation.[/b]

[h3]That is right, we are coming to Playstation 4 & 5 later this year. Can this day get any better? You bet it can[/h3]

[h3]Today we have released something that might tickle your fancy - 77p egg: Eggwife. [/h3]

Does it have a [b]dedicated piss button[/b]? Yes, it does. 
Does it allow for [b]unparalleled destructive creativity and jank[/b]? Yes, it does.
Does it have [b]crude and brash humor?[/b] ... Yeah, you get it by now. 

[h3][b]If you like POSTAL: Brain Damaged, you will feel at home with 77p egg: Eggwife[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/

[h2]You can get it on a UBER discount with this bundle[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35038/EGGSTAL_Drain_Bamaged/



[h3]And as a cherry on top of this piss cake we are going to leave this lovely little teaser here  ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/80325d1852c5e10084278bdc416c62614cdba82a.jpg[/img]

[h3]More about it soon! Till then, have a blast with the workshop![/h3]

[h3]Yours truly,[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png[/img]

notes.title: Balancing Act
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE NOW, UPDATE LATER[/h1]

Dudes! We've gone deeper into development of the rebalancing patch that we promised you, so it took a bit longer. But now that it's here, there's a substantial change of pace to the gameplay, and everyone who didn't like to explore the levels Quake-style for ammo and pickups, will now be able to blast through the game Doom Slayer style, getting his stuff from enemy drops. And thais is good because... THE HORDE IS COMING!

[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]

But this is November, and today is today. Play around with the new system, tell us what you think. Haven't picked up the game yet? Not a problem - it just went on a WEEK LONG sale and is available 20% off. On top of that, there are new purchase options for POSTAL: Brain Damaged, shaving off another 15% off the price if you buy it via bundle with POSTAL REDUX, and our newly released sensational Quake-like horror shooter, INCISION:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28026/BRAIN_INCISION/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28069/ASYLUM_ASSEMBLY/

[h2]CHANGELOG[/h2]


[list]
[*] [b]Added smart loot system, enemies will drop ammo for basic weapons now and health when it’s low. [/b]
[*] [b]Stunnable enemies are now stunned when hooked[/b]
[*] Unity updated to the newest version
[*] Fixed audio slider inconsistency
[*] Increased font size in loading screen for better steam deck compatibility
[*] Fixed input glyphs displaying wrong in tutorials
[*] Fixed Pentrator trail particle
[*] Fixed smart pistol trail particle
[*] Fixed quick save slot saving inconsistency, should work as expected now. This should fix most of the saving issues.
[*] Added scripted combat music to some fight sequences , a lot more combat music in general
[*] Slowed down nail gun projectiles to differentiate it from the minigun
[*] A lot of minor bug fixes
[/list]

Buy games!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/0703e4c0718a8efe5be90b59356042bc0910a9e2.png[/img]

notes.title: POST-release Patch 1
notes.content:
[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

As we all know, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b][/url] is [i]PERFECT[/i], but we are Hyperstrange, so - naturally - we want to make it [b][i]PERFECTER[/i][/b]. So here's our first POST-release patch. But first, a POSTAL-babe!

[previewyoutube=Cgm6FatDbs0;full][/previewyoutube]

YEAH! Feast your eyes on that beauty, before the beauty feasts on your eyes! You're gonna need them to read...

[h2]THE CHANGELOG[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed second boss saving issues
[*] Fixed end boss saving issues
[*] Quicksaves are saved on disk upon saving, instead of when quitting the game
[*] Cutscenes force vsync for their duration, should fix screen tearing
[*] Final boss overlapping audio fixed
[*] Added "-novideo" launch option, might help with game crashing in certain instances
[*] The prison showers in "Bareback redemption" shouldn't block progress now
[*] Suburbia leaderboard exploit fixed
[*] Sniffing in the vip zone aquarium breaking blocker fixed
[*] Sniffing in the vip zone blue key killplane added
[*] Fixed quick pills effect persisting through scene changes
[*] Ragdoll and physical object saving should not cause performance issues anymore
[*] Penterator moaning can be adjusted in audio settings now
[*] ammo capacity increased for all weapons, should make ammo management easier for now. The issue will be addressed properly in the balancing update
[*] ambient stopping aftewr player death fixed
[*] fixed leocalisation of move left and move right in control settings
[*] achievement description fixed (GYMCEL, TAKE THE BLUE PILL, DOUBLE THE EXCITEMENT)
[*] added default controller template for steam
[*] fixed weapon wheel time slowdown persisting between scenes
[*] fixed kill plane/reset level exploit
[*] combat music condition checking fixed, should be way more consistent now
[*] added optional dynamic combat music, you can set number of hostiles that trigger combat music in audio settings (0 disables dynamic combat music)
[*] all beam attacks have their audio moved to end point, you can actually hear the beams now
[*] Unity engine version updated[/list]

Yeah, beam enemies should *feel* more fair now. Stop crying. As said before, today's update is only the first one ahead in the imminent future. Here's the summary of things to expect:

[h2]THE ROADMAP[/h2]
[list][*] [strike][b]Post-release fix [/b]- an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release[/strike]
[*] [b]Balancing update[/b] - some players, as well as [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ld5VPBIQeSM]some internet micro-celebrities[/url], have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)
[*] [b]New playmodes[/b] - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
[*] [b]More to be announced![/b][/list]

Are we done for today? Nope! There's one more thing. We really want you to follow [b][url=https://twitter.com/HYPERSTRANGE]Hyperstrange Twitter[/url][/b] and join [b][url=https://discord.gg/sn7k4KAahw]Hyperstrange Discord[/url][/b]. Why? So you don't miss out on fun stuff, such as...

[h2]THE FAN ART COMPO[/h2]

Damn. You missed the submission deadline. Should've listened and followed that [b][url=https://twitter.com/HYPERSTRANGE]Hyperstrange Twitter[/url][/b] and joined [b][url=https://discord.gg/sn7k4KAahw]Hyperstrange Discord[/url][/b]. There were some very nice prizes, too! But hey, you're right on time too see some GREAT fan art by some of the winners:

[url=https://twitter.com/JoseSlca/status/1540159878559416326][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/5611b1842f69a182d45dfc316779fd9dfc3026e4.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PSYCHODELlCS/status/1543692888655085568][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/c92e02a5ccb9de3a954cc3039b9360fb2448f71c.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/Pocketninja85/status/1537901570448183298][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/eccefd82e459f06fb2ba99dd0f04b81a765a764e.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/Rquattroki/status/1538683150368395264][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/525421fe2efa18888af902f8c2ed887f090979a3.png[/img][/url]

Yup, that's all. You can all go now, and adjust the Penetrator's moaning in the audio settings, or try if that exploit for getting a time on Suburbia leader boards was really fixed-fixed. Really, go! Nothing more to see here.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]
[h2]Hyperstrange & RWS[/h2]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged FULL LAUNCH, along with Boomer-shooter bundles aplenty!
notes.content:
[h1]DOOMERS, BOOMERS, POSTAL ENJOYERS![/h1]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Hyperstrange][b]HYPERSTRANGE[/b][/url] Doom-inspired, boomer-shooter take on [b]Running With Scissors[/b] cult POSTAL series is finally here, so we'd ask you to line up in orderly fashion and proceed towards Steam Checkout. It's 6/9, [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b] day, everyone!

[h3]NOTE: OST + Art Book Availability[/h3]

[b]We know there's many of you eagerly awaiting to toss a coin to our musicians and artists. However technical difficulties that are beyond our control prevent us from uploading and distributing DLC content at this time. We hope this can be resolved soon, and we're very sorry for your troube.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/

You can grab [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b] right now, with a special release-week discount of 15% OFF. But that's not all. PBD is our tribute to the entire community of shooter fans, and Doom enjoyers (even those, who like their Doom turn-based, like in [b]Jupiter Hell[/b]). If you're one of us, we want to thank you, by offering you even further discount on PBD. Same goes to our Hyperstrange friends who have supported us on our journey playing ELDERBORN, CROSSBOW, and our more recent productions. Take a look at the deals isted below and see if you can chip off few extra bucks off the price.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26547/From_DUSK_Till_DUDE/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26549/Brain_Reaper/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26550/Brawns_and_Brains/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26556/ELDERBRAIN_Damaged/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26557/Dude_West/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26624/Cheesy_OneLiners_Galore/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26558/Leys_RAYZE_Dude/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26555/DUDE_on_DUDE_vol_1/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26554/DUDE_on_DUDE_vol_2/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26559/Brain_Damaged_Bloodnight/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26600/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged_x_Project_Warlock_2/

So many excuses to get Brain Damaged! Trust us. It's worth it. And every single of this games is well worth your time, so why stop at just buying PBD?

[previewyoutube=p-UmEShue-A;full][/previewyoutube]

Still, make sure you have time to go deep down the rabbit hole of the Dude's freakshow of a psyche!

[h2]Story time![/h2]

In preparation for POSTAL: Brain Damaged arrival your overlords at Running With Scissors conceived a video game franchise and nurtured it for a quarter of a century. The world-wide cult formed around its protagonist, a multi-incarnate entity known as the Dude. After their idol’s second coming, the believers were put to a test and most will agree the third coming never happened. Surprisingly, the fourth coming did take place setting apart the zealots from those of little faith. But then, a vessel has been found in the slavic wilds of Europe to be inseminated with… inspiration. And so, another coming of the Dude was foretold. Neither third, nor fifth, something else entirely. A HARD coming.

[previewyoutube=y6B9gM26KRM;full][/previewyoutube]

Scholars argue where this new incarnation of the Dude - the Brain Damaged Dude - falls in the dude-linage and continuum. Some propose the 3rd Dude should be considered an impostor, if not Antidude, and the BD Dude is the „real shit”. Others are convinced all Dudes are one, with some pointing out there’s the Dude Father and Dude Son mentioned in the scripture. Those more scientifically inclined adhere to a multi-dimensional theory stating that each Dude exists in a separate paralel universe. Those closer to enlightenment correct them saying: „no, not paralel, it’s actually more like perpendicular, a bit askew, and generally wobbly universe”. All of them are correct. One thing is certain - whatever its actual connection to the POSTALVERSE cannon and dogma might be, 6/9 is the day of reckoning and [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged is here to SLAP![/b]

[h2]Enjoy![/h2]

[h2]Your true friends & family,[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/3852dd0b7c44205dda883df53963bede2e5bc449.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/993e5583c7dc72aba2fc76be97c8b9a3755d293c.png[/img][/url]&[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/7d761773c887fe6eca65718f8ed0a47c6139c2ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/b9d8a114b0ef22b971bec2ba798f0ed3571cf9e5.png[/img][/url]


[h2]PS. Coming up NEXT from Hyperstrange:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
Supplice is a stylish throwback shooter inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh. Make sure to check out the DEMO and wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
You know you'll enjoy POSTAL made by Hyperstrange. What if POSTAL was made by Monthy Python? EGGWIFE is half-game, half-shitpost, all-around British. After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator. Make sure to wishlist the game, etiquette demands it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693290/Skullstone/
Skullstone is a true to its form dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, real-time tactics combat, and first-person view. Lead a party of adventurers into the under-realm, looking for glory, gold, and a solution to the ancient evil plaguing the town above. Well, adventurer? Get crawling! Check out the DEMO i wishlist the game.
